def load() -> pd.DataFrame:
    df = pd.read_csv('data/legal/input/csn-data-book-2024-csv/CSVs/2024_CSN_State_Top_Ten_Report_Categories.csv', header=None, skiprows=1)
    df.columns = ['State', 'Category', 'Reports', 'Percentage']
    df = df.dropna(how='all')
    df = df[df['State'] != 'State']  # drop repeated header rows
    return df
